Bayan dakatawa na aƙalla minti ɗaya, waƙoƙin da suka fi minti 20 suna ci gaba da kunnawa \'yan sakan kaɗan kafin.
A koyaushe a yi wasa lokacin da belun kunne ko na\'urar sauti ta mota ta haɗu.
Kowane lokaci da belun kunne na Bluetooth (misali na mota), belun kunne na waya ko na USB ya haɗu, za a fara kunnawa. Yana aiki yayin da Retro Player ke buɗe ko kuma an dakatar da shi a sanarwa.

Wannan yana goge matsayi na kunnawa, abubuwan da aka fi so, babban fayil ɗin da aka buɗe, jigogi, harshe, da saitunan daidaita sauti. Goge komai kuma yana mantawa da ƙarin babban fayil ɗin ɗakin karatu. Ba a goge fayilolin kiɗa da jerin waƙoƙi a kan diski ba.

Ajiye ƙananan zaɓuɓɓuka, duba yanayin, ci gaba da kunnawa, daidaita sauti, jigo, da zaɓuɓɓukan harshe.
Ba a taba kwafa fayilolin sauti cikin kundin bayanai na manhaja ba. Ƙara babban fayilolin ɗakinsa, sannan Retro Player zai karanta fayiloli kai tsaye daga diski.
Jerin waƙoƙi fayiloli ne .m3u kawai da aka adana a cikin babban fayil ɗin ɗakin karatu naka. Za ka iya gyara su a cikin manhaja ko da kowanne mai gyara rubutu.
Retro Player yana adana bayanan ajiyarsa a yankin tallafi na keɓaɓɓen manhaja a ajiyar ciki. Fayilolin kiɗanka suna zaune a cikin kundin adireshin da ka zaɓa ta mai zaɓar kundin adireshin tsarin.

Idan ana kunna sauti, Retro Player yana gudanar da sabis na kafofin watsa labarai a gaba don ci gaba da kunnawa idan ka kulle wayar ko ka canza manhajoji, tare da maɓallan sarrafa kunnawa a sanarwar tsarin. Goge manhajar daga Jerin Manhajoji da aka yi kwanan nan yana dakatar da kunnawa kuma yana cire sanarwar.
